sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Bukijutsu, Water Release, Lightning Release, Storm Branch

system.description:
You coat your hand in lightning making it act like a buzzsaw around your striking implement.

You strike out in an arc, at every creature in range. Make a single melee Taijutsu (or Ninjutsu) attack, comparing the result vs each creatures AC, dealing either your [Unarmed Damage] or [Weapon Damage] + 2d6 lightning damage.

If a target creature spends their reaction to cast a jutsu that grants them temporary hit points or a bonus to their AC, if you still score a hit, increase the damage dealt by 2d6 lightning damage.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, the damage by 1d6, and the size of the cone by 5 feet.
